result.topic_en: Ramanujan states the Lambert-series formula for the coefficients Q_4(N) of the fourth power of the theta series (sums of four squares), deduces Q_4(N) ≤ σ_1(N) and a Dirichlet-series identity, and begins computing the coefficients explicitly via prime factorization.
result.transcription:
Add MS a 94^{18 (47)} (47) (91)

72. Let
$(1+2q+2q^4+2q^9+\cdots)^4$
$= 1+8\{Q_4(1)q + Q_4(2)q^2 + Q_4(3)q^3+\cdots\}$.
Then, by means of Elliptic functions, we can show that
(384) $Q_4(1)q + Q_4(2)q^2 + Q_4(3)q^3+\cdots\cdots$
$= \frac{q}{1-q} + \frac{2q^2}{1+q^2} + \frac{3q^3}{1-q^3} + \frac{4q^4}{1+q^4} + \cdots\cdots$
$= \frac{q}{1-q} + \frac{2q^2}{1-q^2} + \frac{3q^3}{1-q^3} + \frac{4q^4}{1-q^4} + \cdots$
$-\left(\frac{4q^4}{1-q^4} + \frac{8q^8}{1-q^8} + \frac{12q^{12}}{1-q^{12}} + \cdots\right)$
But
$\frac{q}{1-q} + \frac{2q^2}{1-q^2} + \frac{3q^3}{1-q^3} + \cdots\cdots$
$= \sigma_1(1)q + \sigma_1(2)q^2 + \sigma_1(3)q^3 + \cdots\cdots$
It follows that
(385) $Q_4(N) \leqslant \sigma_1(N)$
for all values of $N$. It also follows from (384) that
(386) $(1-4^{1-s})\zeta(s)\zeta(s-1) = 1^{-s}Q_4(1) + 2^{-s}Q_4(2) + 3^{-s}Q_4(3) + \cdots$
Let $N = 2^{a_2}3^{a_3}5^{a_5}\cdots\cdots p^{a_p}$
where $a_x \geqslant 0$. Then, [-if N is not a multiple of 4, then-] the coefficient of $q^N$ in
$\frac{q}{1-q} + \frac{2q^2}{1-q^2} + \frac{3q^3}{1-q^3} + \cdots\cdots$
is $N.\frac{1-2^{-a_2-1}}{1-2^{-1}}.\frac{1-3^{-a_3-1}}{1-3^{-1}}.\frac{1-5^{-a_5-1}}{1-5^{-1}}\cdots\cdots\frac{1-p^{-a_p-1}}{1-p^{-1}}$;
and that in
$\frac{4q^4}{1-q^4} + \frac{8q^8}{1-q^8} + \frac{12q^{12}}{1-q^{12}} + \cdots\cdots$
